name: ZX_PTNR_TAX_LINES_INT
description: This interface table contains the imported tax lines calculated by tax partners for a transaction.

columns.name: LINES_DET_FACTOR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the transaction line.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Internal organization identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Event class code of the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Transaction identifier for this tax line calculated by third-party service provider.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier for this tax line calculated by third-party service provider.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Column to record the level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for this tax line calculated by third-party service provider.

columns.name: TAX

columns.description: Tax status code for this tax line calculated by third-party service provider.

columns.description: Tax rate for this tax line calculated by third-party service provider.

columns.description: Tax rate code for this tax line calculated by third-party service provider.

columns.name: PLACE_OF_SUPPLY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code for place of supply type.

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE

columns.name: TAX_CURRENCY_CODE

columns.name: TAX_AMT_TAX_CURR
columns.description: Tax amount in tax currency for this tax line calculated by third-party service provider.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_TAX_AMT
columns.description: Unrounded tax amount for this tax line.

columns.name: TAXABLE_AMT
columns.description: Taxable amount in transaction currency.

columns.name: TAXABLE_AMT_TAX_CURR
columns.description: Taxable amount in tax currency for this tax calculated by third-party service provider.

columns.name: UNROUNDED_TAXABLE_AMT

columns.name: TAX_POINT_BASIS

columns.name: EXEMPT_CERTIFICATE_NUMBER

columns.name: EXEMPT_RATE_MODIFIER

columns.name: TAX_AMT_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this tax line is inclusive. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: SELF_ASSESSED_FLAG

columns.name: TAX_REGISTRATION_NUMBER

columns.name: THRESHOLD_INDICATOR_FLAG
